grades: High school juniors and seniors (juniors favored)
name: Disadvantaged High School Student Summer Research Program
org: University of Arizona College of Medicine, Tucson
what_you_do: Work as a paid summer research helper. It is at the University of Arizona College of Medicine in Tucson. The research is medical.
who_can_apply: High school students, especially juniors. They come from backgrounds that are hard in money, school or social ways. You need a 3.0 GPA, 2 recommendation letters, a science fair or research example, U.S. citizenship or a permanent visa, and a Social Security number.
pay_detail: Federal minimum hourly wage, 40 hours a week for the length of the program
deadline_text: No dates or deadline listed on the page.
how_to_apply: Send in the form with a 1 to 2 page essay. The essay topic is "Why I love science and what the summer medical research apprenticeship will mean to me". The page points to ignorance.medicine.arizona.edu for more but does not give the steps.
notes: Applicants must have a Social Security number. Dates and deadline are not posted. Contact the College of Medicine to confirm.
